photos.c: 1. One of the most glorious sights in athletics is the start of the Senior Men's National Cross Country Championships. Half a mile into the 2000 race at Stowe School, Buckinghhamshire, and the field is led by Belgrave's Paul Evans with Paul Freary just behind him and to the right. On the left, behind 2516 is Kevin Nash and next but one above 2321 is Rob McHarg. On the right, behind the orange vested .24 is Jason Lobo, making a more conservative start, with Lee Hurst next but one on the left of .24. In the centre, just behind and to the right of the Blackheath vest is Alaster Stewart and next on the right, with only his claret bandana showing is Charles Herrington. That's eight in the top 100 and they spent the next half mile gaining even more forward positions. You might have to take the Editor's word for this one: on the skyline just to the left of the tree can be seen Phil Carstairs' thinning thatch. Will Cockerell has also been picked out in this vicinity by one viewer - but blowed if we can find him now!

Right: An hour before "National" race time. Bill Laws and John Jeffery have driven back to Milton Keynes to pick up Paul Evans whose car has broken down, leaving the rest of the team to pose for the pre-race photo. Back row: Eric Hall (President), Don Anderson, Paul Coughlan, Alan Mead, Alaster Stewart, Paul Freary, Jason Lobo, Kevin Nash, Phil Carstairs, Rob Harding. Front: Darryl Ochse, Will Cockerell, Charles Herrington, Lee Hurst, Rob McHarg.

Above: Irish eyes were not the only ones smiling when the the Belgrave team collected their prizes in Wallace Park. Rob McHarg, Paul Freary, Alaster Stewart, Yacin Yusuf (crouching), Jason Lobo and Spencer Barden enjoy being Irish Road Relay Champions.

Belgrave's Winning AAA 12-Stage Team at Sutton Park. Back row: Andy Graffin, Spencer Barden, Paul Freary, Stephen Sharp, Alaster Stewart, David Anderson, Allen Graffin, Paul Evans. Front row: Lee Hurst, Mark Miles, Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward, Charles Herrington.

Third from left: Alaster Stewart took leg 11 and ran a personal best for the long stage; the Belgrave lead went up to over 2 minutes. Sadly, Al became injured some time after this high and has yet to make a return to training.

Bottom right: The victorious Belgrave crew can't stop smiling after retaining their title. Standing: Jonathan Blackledge (stage 6), Al Stewart (11), Kevin Nash (3), Adam Zawadski (12), Martin Dent (7), Paul Freary (1), Paul Evans (9 - and what proved to be his last team run for Belgrave), David Anderson (4). Kneeling: Allen Graffin (5), Will Cockerell (10), Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward (8), Stephen Sharp (2).

Above: Stephen Sharp (stage 6), Phil Wicks (2), Jonathan Blackledge (5), Spencer Barden (4), Alaster Stewart (1) and Tim Watson (3) receive the Ian Logan Trophy – Belgrave’s fourth year of being top of the pile at Rushmoor Arena.  Only Stephen and Jonathan remained in the squad from 2004’s winning line-up.
